title: Five knobs, and only one of them is a goal rather than a limit
subtitle: MaxGCPauseMillis states an intent and lets G1 size the young generation; the others pin values and remove that freedom.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis  (default 200)
nodes.detail: a pause goal; G1 sizes the young generation to meet it

nodes.label: -XX:MaxNewSize or -Xmn
nodes.detail:
caps the young generation; Oracle warns that pinning it
turns off pause-time control

nodes.label: -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent
nodes.detail: when concurrent marking starts, adaptive by default

nodes.label: -Xlog:gc* and JFR
nodes.detail: how you observe any of the above
